# Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tmap)

source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

raster_directory <- here::here("2-data", "rasters")
model_directory <- here::here("2-data", "models")
table_directory <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables")
dir.create(table_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

# Environmental predictors

```{r}
predictor_files <- c(
  Depth = "rast_depth.tif",
  `Dissolved Oxygen` = "rast_do.tif",
  Salinity = "rast_sal.tif",
  Sediment = "rast_sed.tif",
  Turbidity = "rast_turb.tif",
  `Water Temperature` = "rast_wTemp.tif"
)
predictors <- terra::rast(file.path(raster_directory, predictor_files))
names(predictors) <- names(predictor_files)

# Create mask that represents area covered by all prediction rasters.
valid_layers <- terra::app(is.finite(predictors), "sum")
complete_mask <- terra::ifel(valid_layers == terra::nlyr(predictors), 1, NA)

# convert to raster for dismo package
model_stack <- terra::mask(predictors, complete_mask) %>% raster::stack()

# return to proper CRS after raster conversion
raster::crs(model_stack) <- terra::crs(predictors) 
```

# Presence and background points

Keep one oyster occurrence per complete predictor cell. Sample 1,000 background points from other complete cells.

```{r}

# Load and thin presence data
p <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "oys_proc.rds")) %>%
  sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326") %>%
  mutate(
    lon = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  GeoThinneR::thin_points(
    lon_col = "lon",
    lat_col = "lat",
    method = "distance",
    thin_dist = 1,
    seed = 42
  ) %>%
  GeoThinneR::largest() %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  sf::st_transform(crs = terra::crs(predictors))

# Create background data
set.seed(42)
b <- dismo::randomPoints(
  raster::raster(complete_mask),
  n = 500,
  p = sf::st_coordinates(p)
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(p))

# Merge into one data frame
pb <- rbind(
  sf::st_sf(pb = 1L, geometry = sf::st_geometry(p)),
  sf::st_sf(pb = 0L, geometry = sf::st_geometry(b))
) %>% 
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
)


```

Of the `r nrow(occurrences)` oyster records, `r sum(valid_presence)` had complete predictor values. After retaining one occurrence per cell, the model used `r nrow(presences)` presence points and `r nrow(background)` background points.

```{r}
#| label: fig-maxent-points
#| fig-cap: "Eastern oyster presence and background points used in the MaxEnt model."

study_area <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "study_area.rds")) %>%
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(pb))
pb$point_type <- ifelse(pb$pb == 1L, "Presence", "Background")

tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(complete_mask) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale(values = "grey90"), col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_shape(study_area) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey40") +
  tm_shape(pb) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "point_type",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c(Background = "grey35", Presence = "red3")),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Model points"),
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

# Spatial cross-validation

Assign 5 km spatial blocks to five folds. Hold out one fold at a time and use AUC to measure how well the model ranks held-out presences relative to background points. Omission is the proportion of held-out presences below the 10th percentile of the training presence scores.

```{r}
pb <- sf::st_transform(pb, crs = terra::crs(predictors))
point_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pb)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
presence_bg <- pb$pb

# Create spatial folds
n_folds <- 5L

fold_id <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = pb,
  column = "pb",
  r = complete_mask,
  k = n_folds,
  size = 2500,
  presence_bg = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  plot = FALSE,
  report = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)$folds_ids

fold_counts <- table(
  factor(fold_id, levels = seq_len(n_folds)),
  presence_bg
)

# Fit and evaluate each fold
fold_metrics <- vector("list", n_folds)

for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {
  test <- fold_id == fold
  train_presence <- !test & presence_bg == 1L
  train_background <- !test & presence_bg == 0L
  test_presence <- test & presence_bg == 1L
  test_background <- test & presence_bg == 0L

  fold_model <- dismo::maxent(
    x = model_stack,
    p = point_coords[train_presence, , drop = FALSE],
    a = point_coords[train_background, , drop = FALSE],
    factors = "Sediment",
    removeDuplicates = FALSE,
    path = file.path(model_directory, "maxent_cv", paste0("fold_", fold))
  )

  evaluation <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = point_coords[test_presence, , drop = FALSE],
    a = point_coords[test_background, , drop = FALSE],
    model = fold_model,
    x = model_stack,
    args = "outputformat=logistic"
  )

  # Predict using the training presence values stored by MaxEnt
  training_scores <- dismo::predict(
    fold_model,
    fold_model@presence,
    args = "outputformat=logistic"
  )

  cutoff <- stats::quantile(
    training_scores,
    probs = 0.10,
    names = FALSE
  )

  fold_metrics[[fold]] <- data.frame(
    fold = fold,
    training_presences = nrow(fold_model@presence),
    testing_presences = evaluation@np,
    training_background = nrow(fold_model@absence),
    testing_background = evaluation@na,
    test_auc = evaluation@auc,
    threshold_10pct = cutoff,
    test_omission_10pct = mean(evaluation@presence < cutoff)
  )
}

fold_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(fold_metrics)

# Summarize and save results
metric_summary <- fold_metrics %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    folds = dplyr::n(),
    mean_test_auc = mean(test_auc),
    sd_test_auc = stats::sd(test_auc),
    mean_test_omission_10pct = mean(test_omission_10pct),
    sd_test_omission_10pct = stats::sd(test_omission_10pct)
  )

readr::write_csv(
  fold_metrics,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_metrics.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  metric_summary,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_summary.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  metric_summary,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c(
    "Folds",
    "Mean AUC",
    "SD of AUC",
    "Mean omission",
    "SD of omission"
  ),
  caption = "MaxEnt spatial cross-validation results."
)
```

# Final model and habitat suitability

Fit MaxEnt using all prepared presence and background points. Map relative habitat suitability on the 0 to 1 logistic scale.

```{r}
#| label: fig-maxent-suitability
#| fig-cap: "Relative Eastern oyster habitat suitability in the Pensacola Bay System."

pb <- sf::st_transform(pb, crs = terra::crs(predictors))
point_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pb)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]

final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = model_stack,
  p = point_coords[pb$pb == 1L, , drop = FALSE],
  a = point_coords[pb$pb == 0L, , drop = FALSE],
  factors = "Sediment",
  removeDuplicates = FALSE,
  path = file.path(model_directory, "maxent_final")
)

saveRDS(
  final_model,
  file.path(model_directory, "maxent_final_model.rds")
)

maxent_suitability <- dismo::predict(
  final_model,
  model_stack,
  args = output_args,
  filename = file.path(raster_directory, "maxent_suitability.tif"),
  format = "GTiff",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

Plot the model

```{r}
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")

my_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(study_area)

p_map <-
  tmap::tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tmap::tm_shape(maxent_suitability, bbox = my_bbox) +
  tmap::tm_raster(
    col_alpha = 0.85,
    col.scale = tmap::tm_scale_continuous(
      values = "scico.imola",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      value.na = "transparent"
    ),
    col.legend = tmap::tm_legend(
      title = "Relative Suitability",
      title.fontface = 2,
      position = tmap::tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "CENTER"),
      orientation = "landscape",
      na.show = FALSE,
      show = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  tmap::tm_shape(pb[pb$pb == 1L, ]) +
  tmap::tm_dots(
    fill = "black",
    col = "black",
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tmap::tm_layout(
    frame = TRUE,
    inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
  ) +
  tmap::tm_title(
    "Eastern Oyster Habitat Suitability",
    fontface = 2,
    position = tmap::tm_pos_out("center", "top", , pos.h = "left", pos.v = "BOTTOM")
  ) +
  tmap::tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 3)

p_map

tmap::tmap_save(p_map, here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "maps", "Suitability_Map.png"))

```
